texts.li: The year has just turned, and {A_nameDef} wants it started properly: one supper with everyone at the long table, and each of them saying out loud what they mean to do with the year. {A_nameDef} has already decided. It's to {GOAL}, and {A_pronoun} says it will be easier with witnesses.

{A_nameDef} has been telling anyone who will listen that this is the year {A_pronoun}'ll {GOAL}. Now {A_pronoun} wants everyone else to say theirs too, at one supper, so nobody can pretend later that they never said it.
A new year, and {A_nameDef} thinks the colony should begin it at one table, going round in turn and saying what each means to do. Some will mumble, {A_nameDef} says, and that is allowed.
[again] The year has turned again, and {A_nameDef} has been setting places at the long table since noon. What people said last year is still remembered, some of it fondly.
[tradition] It's time for the year's first supper. {A_nameDef} still has a list of what everyone said last time, and means to read it out before the new round starts.
[missed] Nobody said anything out loud at the start of last year, and {A_nameDef} thinks the year went the way it did because of it.

li.label: Everyone says it, at one supper
li.outcome: They ate together and went round the table, each saying what they mean to do with the year. Some said it quietly, and one or two decided on something there and then.

outcomes.li: [again] They went round the table again, and a few were teased about what they had said last year. Then everyone said this year's.

li.label: Only those who want to say it
li.outcome: They had supper together, and those who had something in mind for the year said it. Nobody was pressed.

li.label: Not this year
li.outcome: The year started like any other week.{A_nameDef} didn't tell anyone {A_possessive} aim for the year after all.
